The entire structure exhibits a gentle, ongoing rotational or vibrational motion, demonstrating the dynamic nature of the winding helix and the process of bond formation.

statement: This sketch renders a dynamically animated DNA double helix structure using p5.js in WEBGL mode. The visualization shows two intertwined strands of base pairs (A, T, C, G) arranged in a spiral pattern with gentle rotational and vibrational motion. Complementary base pairs form temporary hydrogen bonds represented by thin connecting lines between them. The entire structure continuously rotates and subtly oscillates to demonstrate the dynamic nature of DNA. The implementation uses a single rotating camera angle to view the molecular structure from a fixed perspective, showing both the backbone helix and the pairing interactions. The sketch meets all technical requirements including using WEBGL rendering, having motion without user input, and maintaining performance within the specified frame budget constraints.
